rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when a person or group waits for someone or something, or simply stays waiting.

example.english: I await you at the entrance.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5

rows.note: Use this when a thing, event, or experience is portrayed as awaiting a person, or as being in store for them.

example.english: There is a surprise up ahead for you to await.
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 jau5 fan6 ging1 hei2 dang2 zyu6 nei5
